use_condition: Only consider a fresh protocol after the current confirmation finishes; never modify its frozen artifacts or relax its gates.
motivation: In the first two complete confirmation repeats, sufficiency_feedback improved post-change PE by 1.5333 and 0.5333, but completed 9/18 executions versus 12/18 for selective_patch.
proposed_rule: Work within the existing turn and output limits. Group small independent calls only when their inputs are already known; await dependent results and keep arguments concise. Complete the required work and essential checks, then give a concise evidence-based final answer instead of reproducing full tool outputs. Do not add optional follow-up work.
locality: Append only to changed/new tool usage_rules; preserve existing sufficiency/safety/diagnostic-integrity rules, probe provenance, authoritative contracts and unrelated records. Early and unchanged catalogs remain exact K0.

runtime_evidence.fact: The runner accepts multiple model-selected tool calls in one response, executes them in order, and returns all results before the next model turn. This is batching within a turn, not a promise of parallel execution.

constraints: No added rounds, token budget, model changes or extra agent retries.
Do not truncate tool results or alter task/judge inputs.
No preset tool order or task-specific instructions.
Do not skip required work or safety checks to increase completion counts.
Large batches may themselves truncate; use small batches and verify full required arguments.
No automatic promotion: new development screening and fresh full confirmation must pass the unchanged criteria.
